candidate.reuse: Reuse FFT/window/spectrum/complex/synthesis/multiply buffers and Python input dictionary; preserve float32 multiply then add rounding. Preserve exact PCM16 clipping/rounding/grid without constructing an int16 byte array only to decode it again.
candidate.io: Explicit CPU binding of fixed float32 output buffers; two complete recurrent-state sets alternate. Inputs and outputs of the same invocation never alias. No copy_outputs_to_cpu or shape guessing.
candidate.unchanged: Original pinned GTCRN/Silero weights, CPU provider, thread bounds, STFT512/hop256/periodic sqrt-Hann, state ordering, output lengths/flush, original endpoint/VAD rules and constructor32 zero-frame warmup.
candidate.unsupported_binding_or_source_change: Fail explicitly; no silent fallback or production file replacement

synthetic_validation.coverage: 0/1/255/256/257/319/320/512/1001sample streamed boundaries; exact waveform/length/flush; recurrent sequence and no-alias ping-pong; reset; explicit binding refusal; bit-identical PCM16 quantization including clipping and signed zero; baseline source pin. Synthetic session does not establish real-model performance.

windows_cpu_public_validation.limit: Small ordered host-only diagnostic: combined median about2.9percent below baseline median, reuse alone about0.5percent. No causal ARM speed claim, uncertainty bound, realtime or whole-board acceptance. Timing is denoiser-only; full gate has numerical/VAD/endpoint checks.

adapter_argv_template: <parent latest diagnostic probe with proc-race fixes>
parent_execution.guards: Adapter delegates the parent's latest probe unchanged, including proc-race fixes, version/resource/idle checks, own-priority restoration and UI/identity telemetry. It patches the chosen class in this process only and tags the result with candidate and probe hashes.
parent_execution.ort_matrix: Keep original ORT1.17.3 baseline and candidate separate from the explicit isolated ORT1.19.2 upgrade. The parent's probe version guard remains unchanged; use a separately reviewed version-aware probe for new ORT, never bypass the guard.
parent_execution.acceptance: Verify numerical/VAD/endpoint equality on actual ARM runtime, compare matched face-active UI/camera load, then run original8-frame paced pipeline. Small host allocation savings may be insufficient. No production default was changed.
